title: The goal switch deletes the goal it leaves, and no goal's checks are carried as a floor
scope:
what the driver's goal switch does to the goal it leaves, and what a goal's plan holds besides its own
checks. Which goal is live, and how the chain is ordered, are [0222](0222.md)'s and unchanged. The
one-time deletion of the goals walked before `goal-closeout` is that goal's Stage 6, not this rule.
dependsOnText:
[0222](0222.md) for the chain record and the floor as a view, [0225](0225.md) for the
graduated floor checks, and [0226](0226.md) for the selection store that keys the sweep.
